name: source_dataset_id
description: Source GA4 BigQuery dataset / property identifier (e.g. analytics_123456789)

name: transaction_id
description: Unique ecommerce transaction ID (canonical winner per source_dataset_id)

name: session_key
description: Winning session foreign key referencing fct_ga4_sessions

name: user_pseudo_id
description: GA4 user identifier on the winning purchase event

name: ga_session_id
description: GA4 integer session ID on the winning purchase event; NULL for cookieless pings

name: transaction_timestamp
description: Canonical UTC timestamp of the winning purchase event (TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp))

name: transaction_date_est
description: Transaction date in Eastern Time - PARTITION KEY

name: transaction_timestamp_est
description: Transaction timestamp in Eastern Time

name: purchase_revenue
description: Canonical monetary value recorded on the earliest winning purchase event

name: tax_value
description: Tax amount recorded on the winning purchase event

name: shipping_value
description: Shipping amount recorded on the winning purchase event

name: coupon
description: Order-level coupon code extracted from event_params on the winning purchase event

name: currency
description: Transaction currency code extracted from event_params/item_params, or UNKNOWN when omitted

name: items_count
description: Number of line-item structs present on the winning purchase event (may be 0)

name: total_item_quantity
description: Total item units recorded on the winning purchase event

name: marketing_channel
description: Attributed marketing channel of the winning purchase event

name: utm_source
description: Attributed source at time of purchase

name: utm_medium
description: Attributed medium at time of purchase

name: utm_campaign
description: Attributed campaign at time of purchase

name: duplicate_purchase_event_count
description: Approximate observed-window diagnostic counter (>= 1) of raw purchase events seen for this (source_dataset_id, transaction_id); exact within a single full-history scan and a lower-bound observed estimate across partial, overlapping, or expired-shard rescans

name: distinct_purchase_session_count
description: Approximate observed-window diagnostic counter (>= 1) of distinct session_key values seen firing this transaction_id; exact within a single full-history scan and a lower-bound observed estimate across partial, overlapping, or expired-shard rescans

name: first_observed_timestamp
description: Earliest observed UTC purchase event timestamp (matches transaction_timestamp)

name: last_observed_timestamp
description: Latest observed UTC purchase event timestamp across any duplicate fires

name: min_observed_revenue
description: Minimum purchase_revenue observed across all fires of this transaction_id

name: max_observed_revenue
description: Maximum purchase_revenue observed across all fires of this transaction_id

name: has_amount_disagreement
description: 1 if duplicate fires reported differing purchase_revenue values, 0 otherwise

name: has_items_disagreement
description: 1 if duplicate fires reported differing item array payloads, 0 otherwise

name: has_session_disagreement
description: 1 if the same transaction_id fired across more than one session_key, 0 otherwise

name: processed_at
description: ETL load timestamp
